propositions: Workflow editor must expose authored YAML/BPMN as editable topology separate from a read-only Effective Policy projection derived from CriteriaSnapshot
Effective Policy panel displays criterion provenance (digest/source, gate, tier, posture, applicability, enabled state) without serializing mutations back to workflow or project routing
Project code-review LLM criteria require non-empty non-list-validated applies_to globs; missing or empty selectors are rejected with remediation hint to use repository-wide ["**"]
Built-in criteria, project DET, and plan-review criteria retain their existing authoring semantics and bypass the applies_to glob validation rule
CriteriaSnapshot load or validation failure marks Effective Policy unavailable with actionable error and prevents save; no silent fallback to packaged defaults
Authored workflow document round-trips byte-equivalently while Effective Policy view updates independently on policy changes
